name: Phanuel
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: “And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser”. Her father Phanuel was of the tribe of Asher, so she was a child of Asher. They thought the northern tribes were all gone: where are they? She was of that remnant that remained, that humbled themselves, going back to Hezekiah’s time and Asa’s time.

note.label: GENTILES: NORTHERN KINGDOM IN THE NEW TESTAMENT
